editorial.blurb: Lao Sze Chuan serves up generously portioned Chinese favorites with genuine warmth and quick QR-code ordering that keeps things running smoothly.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive right after opening for a quieter experience, sign up for their rewards program at the table to snag free spring rolls, and order via the QR code menu—it's more accurate than the paper menus they have on hand.
